doc.title: Hal Galper interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 27, 2022

title: Asked what Cannonball was like as a boss
summary: Galper deflects the question, joking about being asked what it was like to play with famous musicians.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Cannonball Adderley: the sound, the man, the band

blocks.x: What was Cannonball like as a boss? Or was Nat the boss?
Are you interviewing me or Cannonball?
I get this all the time. Everybody wants to know what it was like to play with this guy or to play with that guy, and eventually I begin to wonder well who are you interviewing?
